title: LLM-as-a-Judge: Reassessing the Performance of LLMs in Extractive QA
authors_zh: Xanh Ho, Jiahao Huang, Florian Boudin, Akiko Aizawa
paper_type_zh: 大语言模型评审可靠性实证研究
best_for_zh: 需要核查问答自动评测可靠性的研究者。
one_line: Audits LLM judging against human labels for extractive QA where EM and F1 can miss valid paraphrases.
审计大语言模型评审能否修正 EM 与 F1 对抽取式问答有效改述的误判。
why: It provides a reproducible reliability test for replacing lexical QA metrics with contextual judgments.
inclusion_reason: Controlled audit of LLM-judge reliability against human labels for extractive QA.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Exact-match and token-F1 score extractive QA answers by surface overlap. They can reject a semantically correct answer with a different form, so reported performance may understate a model's reading ability.

This study evaluates LLM-as-a-judge as an alternative on Quoref, DROP, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultiHopQA. It compares judge verdicts with human judgments and with EM/F1 rather than training a new QA model.

抽取式问答通常以精确匹配（EM）和词元 F1 按表面重合评分；语义正确但表达不同的答案会被判错，从而低估模型的阅读理解能力。

论文在 Quoref、DROP、HotpotQA 与 2WikiMultiHopQA 上检验大语言模型评审能否替代该评分方式：它将评审结论与人工判断及 EM/F1 对照，而非训练新的问答模型。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The contribution is an evaluation audit: instruction-tuned LLMs inspect a question, context, reference answer, and prediction, then decide semantic correctness where EM/F1 only test overlap. The released code and result files cover four QA datasets, 4,193 sampled items, human judgments, prompts, QA predictions, and outputs from Mistral, Llama, and Qwen judges. It is an evaluation artifact, not a training dataset.
核心贡献是一项评测审计：指令微调的大语言模型读取问题、上下文、参考答案和预测答案，在 EM/F1 只检查字面重合之处判断语义正确性。作者公开代码与结果文件，覆盖四个问答集的 4,193 个样本、人工判断、提示词、问答预测及 Mistral、Llama、Qwen 评审输出；它是评测材料，不是训练数据集。

title: Method
方法
html: 1. Sample four QA development sets, label answer types, and exclude yes/no items. 2. Generate zero-shot CoT answers with eight instruction-tuned QA models. 3. Ask Mistral-7B, Llama-3.3-70B, and Qwen-2.5-72B to judge each prediction using the question, context, and reference. 4. Compare verdicts with human labels and EM/F1, including answer-type and self-preference analyses. Code, prompts, inputs, and archives are public; model/API versions and sampling settings must be fixed.
1. 从四个问答开发集抽样、标注答案类型并排除是非题。2. 用八个指令微调模型以零样本思维链生成答案。3. 将问题、上下文、参考答案和预测答案交给 Mistral-7B、Llama-3.3-70B、Qwen-2.5-72B 判别。4. 同人工标签与 EM/F1 比较，并分析答案类型和自偏好。代码、提示词、输入与结果档案公开；复现须固定模型或 API 版本及采样设置。

title: Evidence
证据
html: On 1,288 predictions with human labels, Qwen-as-judge reached correlation 0.85, compared with 0.22 for EM and 0.40 for F1. The study uses four QA datasets and multiple judge families, so the result supports this evaluation setting rather than universal replacement of human review. Job answers remain harder to judge, and the reported lack of self-preference is specific to these tests.
在 1,288 个有人类标签的预测上，Qwen 评审与人工判断的相关系数为 0.85，而 EM 与 F1 分别为 0.22、0.40。实验覆盖四个问答集和多类评审模型，支持这一评测设置下的替代价值，不能证明可普遍取代人工审查。职业类答案仍较难判别；未发现自偏好也仅限于该测试范围。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior extractive-QA protocols treat string overlap as the verdict. This work changes the decision object from overlap to contextual semantic correctness and audits it against human labels across answer types. It does not introduce a new QA dataset or new judge architecture; the useful novelty is the controlled reliability comparison for extractive QA.
既有抽取式问答协议把字符串重合当作最终判决。本文把判决对象改为结合上下文的语义正确性，并在不同答案类型上同人工标签对照审计。它没有提出新的问答数据集或评审架构；新意在于对抽取式问答中评审可靠性的受控比较。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The authors report weaker agreement for ambiguous job answers, where the gold answer may list multiple occupations. Their results also cover sampled development data and three judge models, not adversarial prompts or all QA formats. Before reuse, re-label a held-out slice for the target answer type and test prompt/model sensitivity; do not treat a high correlation as proof of per-item correctness.
作者指出职业类答案更易产生分歧，因为参考答案可能包含多个职业。实验还只覆盖抽样开发集和三种评审模型，未测试对抗提示或所有问答形式。复用前应对目标答案类型的留出样本重标注，并测试提示词和模型敏感性；高相关性不能证明每个单项判决都正确。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For a QA team whose EM/F1 failures may include valid paraphrases, run the released judge on the false-EM subset, retain the verdict and rationale, and audit a human-labeled sample. The output is a corrected evaluation report and a disagreement queue. Do not directly adopt it when context, gold answers, or a suitable human audit set are unavailable.
若问答团队怀疑 EM/F1 判错中包含有效改述，可对 EM 判错子集运行公开评审程序，保留判决与理由，并抽样同人工标签核查。输出是校正后的评测报告与分歧队列。若缺少上下文、参考答案或适合的人工审计集，不应直接采用该流程。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Position: audits whether lexical QA metrics miss semantically correct answers.
  • Lever: judge only EM/F1 disagreements, then compare with human labels.
  • Artifact: repository includes prompts, data archives, predictions, and three judge outputs.
  • Evidence: Qwen judge correlation is 0.85 versus EM 0.22 and F1 0.40 on 1,288 labeled predictions.
  • Reuse: suited to contextual extractive QA; first audit ambiguous answer types and model sensitivity.

• 定位：审计词面问答指标是否漏掉语义正确的答案。
  • 抓手：只复核 EM/F1 分歧样本，再同人工标签比较。
  • 材料：仓库公开提示词、数据档案、预测和三类评审输出。
  • 证据：1,288 个标注预测上，Qwen 相关系数 0.85，EM 为 0.22、F1 为 0.40。
  • 复用：适合有上下文的抽取式问答；先审计歧义答案类型与模型敏感性。
